messages:
emma: heads-up — we had a burst of ECC corrections and ~Xid 13/31 spikes on gpu-node-az3-05 at 03:12 UTC. node started flapping IO and a few lite jobs requeued. thinking we should try a staggered preemptible fallback flow instead of full cordon+drain. low-risk jobs -> preemptible pool, remaining jobs get a short grace to checkpoint. :thinking_face:

kevin: +1 to avoiding hard-drain on first sight. curious about thresholds — what signals would trigger preemptible fallback vs full cordon?

emma: proposed thresholds: Xid error rate > 3/min OR ECC corrected > 200 in 10m -> mark node as "soft-isolate" and emit event to autoscaler. If persistent for 5m more or spike to uncorrected ECC -> cordon+drain. also respect region capacity: EU-west preemptible pool has only 40% spare.

priya: we need kube + slurm parity. for k8s flow suggestion snippet: 
```
# soft-isolate: taint to divert new pods, let existing finish or migrate to preemptible pool
kubectl taint nodes gpu-node-az3-05 redwood/soft-isolate=true:NoSchedule --overwrite
# after grace window, evict best-effort pods with eviction API (not delete)
```
and for slurm: 
```
# mark node DRAIN with reason, leave running jobs until checkpoint window
scontrol update NodeName=gpu-node-az3-05 State=DRain Reason="soft-isolate: ECC spike"
```

oncall-luca: tagging note — please add region and preemptible-capacity tags so routing can pick fallback region with spare capacity. we had this problem last month where fallback picked apac and exploded latency. :grimacing:

kevin: autoscaler config bits to tweak: cooldown window 600s, hysteresis on Xid rate (exponential backoff), and max concurrent evacuations per zone = 2. Also add cost-priority flag so high-cost customers don't get moved to preemptible by default.

emma: agreed. metrics to expose on dashboards: xids_per_min, ecc_corrected_10m, pcie_reset_count, preemptible_burst_usage, regional_spare_ratio. alert levels: warn at soft-isolate threshold, sev at hard-cordon threshold.

priya: we should simulate on staging with a synthetic Xid generator. small run: 3 nodes in eu-west with preemptible pool at 20% capacity. test plan: 1) trigger soft-isolate, 2) ensure only best-effort pods migrate, 3) ensure slurm drains honor checkpoint window, 4) watch autoscaler not oversubscribe fallback region.

infra-bot: scheduled runbook snippet attached: https://runbooks.internal/gpu-evac-staggered-fallback (automated playbook available). Will post results to this thread when finished.

oncall-luca: one caveat — ensure health signals are deduped across multiple daemons (nvml watcher + pci probe) to avoid double-counting. introduce a short debounce window (30s) at signal ingestion tier.

emma: plan: run staging sim tomorrow 09:00 UTC, if green we’ll roll to canary (10% fleet) then region roll with max-concurrent limit. I’ll open a PR with the taint/eviction code + autoscaler flags. tagging @kevin @priya for review. :thumbsup:
